excluded.reason: AUTOMATION-158. 64 END-TO-END tests (IntegrationTests 58, PluginTimeout 2, PluginActivityConcurrency 2, TestPruneStorm 1, ProcessHelperTimeout 1) that stand up REAL infrastructure — live plugin hosts and daemons over temp repos, real file watchers, real child `dotnet` processes — and assert on WALL-CLOCK behaviour: plugin timeouts, process reaping, activity concurrency, TestPrune under a storm of edits. Run from inside the daemon that IS the gate, they nest a daemon in a daemon and contend for the box the outer run is being timed on, so their timing assertions become a function of machine load rather than of the code. Their coverage is excluded for the same family of reasons (no Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage reference: SDK-reflection paths fire nondeterministically and would make the ratchet flaky — see CLAUDE.md). NOT UNGATED: `mise run test-integration` runs them, and CI's reusable workflow runs a solution-wide `dotnet test` that includes them, so they must be green to merge — just not from inside the warm-daemon inner loop. The exclusion is DECLARED: it is logged on every green load and recorded in verdict.json's `scope.excluded`, so a consumer of a `kind: full` verdict sees the gap instead of inferring completeness from a count.
